name: @blotto/postgres-suite
description: The only suite in this repository that executes SQL. Runs the migrations against an EMPTY database and then drives every Postgres-backed store in the backend against the schema they produced (audit 2026-09-11, A-03 / G-03 / G-04 / G-17). Gated on BLOTTO_TEST_DATABASE_URL: without it every case is pending, never silently green.
